ops.title: Design quote and teammate-relay echo damping for signal hooks
ops.description: Teammate-message relays (user events, isMeta null) and assistant prose quoting a hook's own warn message re-trigger signal hooks: 10 such fires in decisions.db, including the 8.15.0 fix's own planning session 0f339270 where recon digests about the stewardship hook tripped it, and where the window-scoped typing-warnings nudge fired on a digest quoting both its tells verbatim. EchoTracker damps only 5 events post-fire in-session (state.py) vs window=15, and cross-agent quotes escape entirely. No reliable transcript marker for relayed or quoted content exists; the teammate-message wrapper prefix is fragile. Needs a real design, possibly family-level (cc-transcript marking relayed content at parse time).

ops.text: a design note or doc records the chosen damping approach and the rejected alternatives with the fire-log evidence
